```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

project_dir <- file.path(path.expand("~"), "Downloads", "AC_combined_analysis", "Adriana_analysis")
tables_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "tables")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "figures")
output_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "output_tables")

dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(mitch)
library(ggrepel)

select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r establish-pc-directions}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PC1 vs cell volume: Spearman r = -0.216
#   -> PC1 reflects TOR/PKA signalling state, not cell size
#   -> s.PC1 positive = active TOR/PKA (ribosome biogenesis on)
#   -> s.PC1 negative = TOR/PKA inhibited (stress response on)
#
# PC2 vs cell volume: Spearman r = +0.795
#   -> PC2 is the primary cell size axis
#   -> s.PC2 positive = genes upregulated in large cells
#   -> s.PC2 negative = genes upregulated in small cells
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_samples <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_samples_AC.txt"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE)

pc_vol_cor <- pca_samples %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_cell_volume)) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_PC1_vol = cor(PC1, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman"),
    cor_PC2_vol = cor(PC2, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman")
  )

cat("PC1 vs cell volume (Spearman r):", round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC1_vol, 3), "\n")
cat("PC2 vs cell volume (Spearman r):", round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC2_vol, 3), "\n")
```

```{r load-data}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PCA gene scores - PC1 and PC2 only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

supp_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "Supp Table 3 updated.xlsx")
table_a   <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3a")
table_c   <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3c")
table_e   <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3e")

cat("Table A dimensions:", nrow(table_a), "genes x", ncol(table_a), "columns\n")
cat("Table C dimensions:", nrow(table_c), "genes x", ncol(table_c), "columns\n")
cat("Table E dimensions:", nrow(table_e), "genes x", ncol(table_e), "columns\n")
```

```{r filter-common-genes}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Filter PCA genes to those present in Table A (Adriana's
# approach) - ensures gene universe is consistent across
# all enrichment analyses in this script.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
common_genes <- intersect(pca_genes$gene_id, table_a$gene_id)
cat("Genes in PCA:", nrow(pca_genes), "\n")
cat("Genes in Table A:", nrow(table_a), "\n")
cat("Common genes used for analysis:", length(common_genes), "\n")

pca_mat <- pca_genes %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% common_genes) %>%
  select(gene_id, PC1, PC2) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")

table_a <- table_a %>% filter(gene_id %in% common_genes)
table_c <- table_c %>% filter(gene_id %in% common_genes)
table_e <- table_e %>% filter(gene_id %in% common_genes)
```

```{r build-genesets}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Table A: binding gene sets (TF binds gene = 1)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
tf_cols_a <- colnames(table_a)[-1]

genesets_a <- map(tf_cols_a, ~table_a %>%
                    filter(.data[[.x]] == 1) %>%
                    pull(gene_id)) %>%
  set_names(tf_cols_a) %>%
  keep(~length(.x) >= 5)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Table C: activated (log2FC < 0) and repressed (log2FC > 0)
# run as separate gene set lists so results can be plotted
# and interpreted independently (Adriana's approach)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
tf_cols_c    <- setdiff(colnames(table_c), c("gene_id", "Kmeans_clusters"))
table_c_long <- table_c %>%
  select(gene_id, all_of(tf_cols_c)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC))

genesets_c_activated <- table_c_long %>%
  filter(log2FC < 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe()

genesets_c_repressed <- table_c_long %>%
  filter(log2FC > 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Table E: direct activated and repressed (bound + regulated)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
tf_cols_e    <- colnames(table_e)[-1]
table_e_long <- table_e %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC))

genesets_e_activated <- table_e_long %>%
  filter(log2FC < 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe()

genesets_e_repressed <- table_e_long %>%
  filter(log2FC > 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe()

cat("Table A binding sets:", length(genesets_a), "\n")
cat("Table C activated:", length(genesets_c_activated),
    "| repressed:", length(genesets_c_repressed), "\n")
cat("Table E direct activated:", length(genesets_e_activated),
    "| direct repressed:", length(genesets_e_repressed), "\n")
```

```{r tor-pka-annotation}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Manual annotation of TFs known to be regulated by TORC1/PKA
# Used to label 2D scatter plots by pathway rather than
# individual TF name, improving biological interpretability
# (from Adriana's script)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
tf_regulation <- tibble(
  TF = c("IFH1", "FHL1", "SFP1", "MSN2", "MSN4", "GCN4",
         "RAP1", "GLN3", "STB1", "MIG1", "MIG2", "ADR1"),
  regulation = c("TORC1/PKA", "TORC1/PKA", "TORC1/PKA",
                 "TORC1/PKA", "TORC1/PKA",
                 "TORC1", "TORC1", "TORC1",
                 "TORC1/PKA", "PKA", "PKA", "PKA")
)
```

```{r run-mitch}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Run mitch separately for each gene set collection.
# Activated and repressed run as separate calls (Adriana's
# approach) so results can be plotted and interpreted
# independently.
# priority = "effect" ranks by s.dist (effect size).
# ---------------------------------------------------------
run_mitch <- function(genesets, label) {
  cat("Running mitch:", label, "\n")
  result <- mitch_calc(
    x        = pca_mat,
    genesets = genesets,
    priority = "effect",
    cores    = 1
  )
  df <- result$enrichment_result %>%
    rename(TF = set)
  cat(" ", nrow(df), "sets tested |",
      sum(df$p.adjustMANOVA < 0.05), "significant (FDR < 0.05)\n")
  df
}

df_a             <- run_mitch(genesets_a,             "Table A (binding)")
df_c_activated   <- run_mitch(genesets_c_activated,   "Table C (activated)")
df_c_repressed   <- run_mitch(genesets_c_repressed,   "Table C (repressed)")
df_e_activated   <- run_mitch(genesets_e_activated,   "Table E (direct activated)")
df_e_repressed   <- run_mitch(genesets_e_repressed,   "Table E (direct repressed)")
```

```{r plot-function}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2D scatter of s.PC1 vs s.PC2.
# Labels the top N TFs by largest absolute PC1 or PC2
# effect size (union of both, Adriana's approach).
# Known TORC1/PKA-regulated TFs are labelled by pathway
# name rather than individual TF name for interpretability.
# All results plotted (not filtered to significant only)
# to show full landscape; significance encoded by colour.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_tf_2d <- function(df, title, n_label = 10,
                       show_regulation = TRUE) {
  # select labels: top n by |s.PC1| union top n by |s.PC2|
  top_pc1 <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(s.PC1))) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_label)

  top_pc2 <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(s.PC2))) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_label)

  labels_df <- bind_rows(top_pc1, top_pc2) %>%
    distinct(TF, .keep_all = TRUE)

  if (show_regulation) {
    labels_df <- labels_df %>%
      left_join(tf_regulation, by = "TF") %>%
      mutate(label = if_else(!is.na(regulation), regulation, TF))
  } else {
    labels_df <- labels_df %>% mutate(label = TF)
  }

  ggplot(df, aes(x = s.PC1, y = s.PC2)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_point(aes(size = setSize,
                   color = -log10(p.adjustMANOVA)),
               alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labels_df,
                    aes(label = label),
                    size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
    scale_color_viridis_c() +
    scale_size_continuous(breaks = c(10, 25, 50, 100, 250)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "PC1 vs cell volume: Spearman r = ",
        round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC1_vol, 3),
        "  |  PC2 vs cell volume: Spearman r = ",
        round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC2_vol, 3)
      ),
      x     = "Effect size PC1 (s.PC1)",
      y     = "Effect size PC2 (s.PC2)",
      size  = "No. target genes per TF",
      color = expression(-log[10]("adj. p-value"))
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40"))
}
```

```{r plots-table-a, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
plot_tf_2d(df_a, "TF enrichment - Table A binding (mitch)")
```

```{r plots-table-c, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
plot_tf_2d(df_c_activated, "TF enrichment - Table C activated (mitch)",
           show_regulation = FALSE)
plot_tf_2d(df_c_repressed, "TF enrichment - Table C repressed (mitch)",
           show_regulation = FALSE)
```

```{r plots-table-e, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
plot_tf_2d(df_e_activated, "TF enrichment - Table E direct activated (mitch)",
           show_regulation = FALSE)
plot_tf_2d(df_e_repressed, "TF enrichment - Table E direct repressed (mitch)",
           show_regulation = FALSE)
```

```{r save-outputs}
write_tsv(df_a,           file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableA.txt"))
write_tsv(df_c_activated, file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableC_activated.txt"))
write_tsv(df_c_repressed, file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableC_repressed.txt"))
write_tsv(df_e_activated, file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableE_activated.txt"))
write_tsv(df_e_repressed, file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableE_repressed.txt"))

plot_configs <- list(
  list(df_a,           "tf_mitch_tableA_2d.png",          "Table A binding",          TRUE),
  list(df_c_activated, "tf_mitch_tableC_activated_2d.png", "Table C activated",        FALSE),
  list(df_c_repressed, "tf_mitch_tableC_repressed_2d.png", "Table C repressed",        FALSE),
  list(df_e_activated, "tf_mitch_tableE_activated_2d.png", "Table E direct activated", FALSE),
  list(df_e_repressed, "tf_mitch_tableE_repressed_2d.png", "Table E direct repressed", FALSE)
)

for (cfg in plot_configs) {
  p <- plot_tf_2d(cfg[[1]],
                  paste("TF enrichment -", cfg[[3]], "(mitch)"),
                  show_regulation = cfg[[4]])
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, cfg[[2]]),
         plot = p, width = 9, height = 8)
}

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
